verdict.rationale: Bland ships an official Web Agent SDK for React/Vanilla JS/Node (bland-docs-13/35), a CLI (bland-docs-12), and API/Pathways references (bland-docs-1) that ai-native builders can code against, plus an MCP server for agent integration. However, there's no evidence of dedicated server-side/backend language SDKs (e.g., Python, Node API client packages with versioning) or a public OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s on openapi.json), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK usage. Missing for 10: documented backend SDK packages (Python/Node), publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec, and community validation of SDK developer experience.
